data.one_liner: Record audio from the microphone to a file with configurable codec, bitrate and sample rate.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to start, pause, resume and stop audio recording on Android, iOS and Web. Supports multiple encoders including AAC, AMR and OPUS and returns the recorded file path.
use_when: You need to capture raw audio input in a Flutter app
Cross‑platform recording (Android, iOS, Web) is required
You want fine‑grained control over codec and bitrate
avoid_when: You only need audio playback (use audioplayers or just_audio)
Complex audio processing or streaming is required
strengths: Zero external native dependencies beyond platform SDKs
Supports multiple codecs and bitrate settings
Works on Android, iOS and Web out of the box
weaknesses: No built‑in audio visualization or amplitude analysis beyond getAmplitude()
Limited to file‑based output, no streaming support
Permission handling must be done manually
data.setup_notes: Add RECORD_AUDIO permission on Android and NSMicrophoneUsageDescription on iOS; no additional Gradle or Xcode changes required.

alternatives.name: record
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a similar simple recording API and is the original package this plugin forks from
